slides.title: RLS Career Overhaul v2.7.1
slides.subtitle: The Ownership Update · September 2026
slides.summary: Every part wears, every tire heats up, and help is one call away.

slides.title: Maintenance, tires and roadside repair
slides.summary: Wear now follows each component's own mileage, tires heat, wear and lose grip in the wet, and help is available on the road.
facts: Wear tracks each component; systems your car doesn't have never fail
Tire heat, compound, rain, terrain and water cooling all change grip; condition saved per vehicle
Gas stations and service spots repair, maintain or tune without sending the car to storage
New Tyre Heat & Wear HUD tile; sell tires through My Parts

slides.title: A full Off Road Recovery career
slides.summary: Own or finance a Recovery Yard and take contracts for stranded cars, trailers, fleet vehicles and heavy equipment.
facts: Multiple offers, pay based on distance, vehicle rewards
New recovery lot by the island refinery; job summary screen
Universal winch restored: Alt+W, smoother and less elastic

slides.title: Complete Engine Packages
slides.summary: Capture an installed engine with its connected parts, then store, swap, install or dismantle the complete package.
facts: Create, store, install or dismantle at the garage computer
Vehicle selection at tuning tents and improved previews
Isolated engine thumbnails and clearer vehicle context

slides.title: Twenty skills and bigger events
slides.summary: Twenty career skills with a redesigned Skills app, and freeroam events grew up.
facts: New skills: Mayhem, Operator, Emergency, Recovery, Speed, Circuit Racing
Licenses, sponsors and major unlocks in the Skills app; existing XP migrates
Burnout competitions and the Tough Truck beach course; sharper AI racers
Profile browser with search, sorting and filters; Career, Story and Custom starts

slides.title: More West Coast to own and explore
slides.summary: Eleven new homes, a Travel Journal with five scenic destinations, and living weather with a real forecast.
facts: Horizon Estate houses, three townhouses, 43rd Alley Compound, budget lots; Move Out option
Travel Journal routes lead into Photo Mode scenes and build an album for Photography XP
Weather app: current conditions, hourly and seven-day forecasts, alerts, day and night settings

slides.title: And everything else
slides.lead: The smaller changes that add up.

columns.heading: Work and Market Watch
items: Civil Service, Logistics and Gig Work surge into high demand, shown in Market Watch
Material contracts can need several materials
Reworked parcel sizes and payouts; B-train trailer jobs
Expanded loaner fleets at logistics sites
BeamEats more reliable on big maps, double Logistics XP

columns.heading: Phone and Marketplace
items: App Store: install career apps early, with a new phone tutorial
Lock screen and banner notifications, per-app settings, Do Not Disturb
Redesigned Marketplace: private sales happen at the seller, dynamic buyer behavior
Edit listings; damaged vehicles can be sold again

columns.heading: Reliability
items: Police pursue only at 10+ over the limit
Standard BeamNG taxi restored; faster loads around vanilla missions
Faster vehicle entry and parts switching
Car meet membership persists; 55 mph drag return road
